sentences.text: Raina Carrillo is a community worker at Inglewood United.

items.text: Carrillo has said she wants Inglewood residents to have more of a say in major city decisions. In a candidate questionnaire, she said she supports affordable and workforce housing, homeownership opportunities and protections against displacement. She proposed holding regular community town halls in every district, with evening meetings so working families can attend. She also called for a traffic plan that includes protected residential parking and directs event parking away from neighborhood streets. Carrillo says transparency starts with making City Hall accessible and accountable, and that Inglewood's biggest need is ensuring residents are not left behind as the city grows.
